economic_mechanism: Relative ranking captures mean-reversion and momentum across instruments
falsifiable_prediction: If cross-sectional IC varies dramatically across horizons, it is not horizon-robust
label: LAB-006 (excess return vs SPY, per-horizon)
purging: Purge gap of 5 sessions between train/val/test to prevent leakage

hyperparameters.note: No hyperparameter tuning allowed. These values are from Phase 18.

statistical_test: one-sided t-test against null IC distribution
pass_criteria: mean_val_IC >= 0.010 AND exceeds null (p<0.05 after Holm) AND temporal stability (positive windows >= 3/5) AND universe consistency (sign agreement) AND required model-family consistency
partial_pass_criteria: mean_val_IC >= 0.005 AND exceeds null (p<0.05) but one robustness criterion not met
fail_criteria: mean_val_IC < 0.005 OR fails to exceed null OR sign reversal across universes
inconclusive_criteria: No genuine holdout data available; test classified as PSEUDO_CONFIRMATORY
model_family_requirement: Confirmatory protocol MUST include Lasso as a pre-registered model family
